title: Numeric observation
summary: Assign the latest pre-index value of a declared numeric social measure, such as a recorded deprivation score, on its supplied scale. This extracts recorded observations; it does not derive an area score from an address, equate different instruments or convert currencies.

required_tables.conditional: Tables, value/unit/time roles and vocabulary required by the supplied index and other event bindings.

required_roles.index: person, event key, start; interval end according to index policy
required_roles.measure: numeric value_as_number and declared scale/unit policy

limitations: See documentation for fixed policies, windows, missingness, coverage, tie order, output schema and analysis limitations.
